{{Youmay|the ground vehicle|the [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barge]] also referred to as a cargo carrier}}
A '''cargo carrier''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] ground vehicle used to move cargo around. They were employed on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Dohu VII]]<ref name="BF">{{JournalCite|1|Breaking Free: The Adventures of Dannen Lifehold}}</ref> and [[Nigel VI]] to shift cargo. A number were present in [[Warehouse 52]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nargo (city)|Nargo]] when it was raided by [[Warehouse bandits|bandits]].<ref name="P">{{WEGCite|story=The Package (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
